bible.text: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... she left me for someone else. Just like that. Like none of it mattered.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It mattered. Your hurt is real, and I'm not asking you to pretend it isn't.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does it feel like You're far away right now?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm not far. I'm closest to you exactly when you're breaking.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What helped you get through your worst heartbreak?
